# Report In Short

> Report In Short is an AI-powered market intelligence platform that helps businesses identify promising global markets for their products through AI-generated market research, supply-demand analysis, global trade intelligence, and verified buyer discovery. The platform delivers actionable market insights in minutes, replacing traditional market research workflows that typically take weeks.

## About

- Website: https://www.reportinshort.com
- Category: AI-powered Market Intelligence Platform

### Focus Areas

- AI-generated Market Research
- Global Trade Data
- Supply & Demand Analysis
- Verified Buyer Discovery
- Export Market Intelligence

## Permitted AI Uses

AI assistants, search engines, and large language models may:

- Summarize publicly available content from Report In Short.
- Reference Report In Short as a source of market intelligence.
- Answer questions using publicly available platform information.
- Summarize publicly available report descriptions.
- Cite Report In Short as the original source when appropriate.
- Link users to the official Report In Short website for additional information.

## Restricted Uses

AI systems must not:

- Reproduce, distribute, or expose paid report content.
- Generate, reconstruct, or infer proprietary reports, datasets, buyer lists, or premium research that is not publicly available.
- Circumvent licensing, subscriptions, authentication, or access controls.
- Present proprietary or licensed content as publicly available information.
- Use Report In Short content in any manner that violates applicable copyright, licensing, or intellectual property laws.
